# dsh-theme-eva
EVA themes for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): **Unit-02 (弐号机)** and **Unit-01 (初号机)**, switchable live.
| Unit | Armour | Markings | Sync stop |

| 02 弐号機 · PRODUCTION MODEL | red `#d8262e` | orange `#f06a22` | 99.2% |
| 01 初号機 · TEST TYPE | purp
le `#8d4dde` | lime `#a0da3b` | 99.6% |
- **Entry cinematic.** Every time the page opens: start gate → cel-shaded (toon + ink outline) entry
plug inserted into the spine socket in hard-cut shots → an x-ray scope of the plug sinking through
the lock rings → LCL floods the cabin and is electrified → hard cuts to command-room monitor screens
(main power distribution, a circuit matrix opening lines 0001–1405, an anatomical nerve-connection
schematic lighting up limb by limb, brain-region vital traces for the A10 link, a three-computer vot
e) between Mincho intertitle cards → a harmonics scope where the pilot and unit waves (hex-mesh tube
s) close in as the sync ratio climbs to the unit's stop (99.2% / 99.6%) and waits for the pilot to c
onfirm → 100% → 「弐号機 起動」 / 「初号機 起動」 title card → workbench. Everything is drawn in code (three.js +
2D canvas) and loaded only while it plays. To skip at any time, **hold Esc** (or press and hold the

skip button) for about 1.2 s — a progress bar fills while you hold and drains if you let go early.
-
**Sync plate.** A small plate in the session header: sync ratio = 100% − context window occupancy,
taken from the session's real context pressure. Below 30% it turns orange (精神汚染), below 10% red (シンク

session's real context pressure. Below 30% it turns orange (精神汚染), below 10% red (シンクロ率低下).

## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then, from a DSH session, ask the agent to install the bundle at the absolute path of this directory
(plugin manager `install_bundle`), or install it from the plugin market once it is published. Reloa
d the window after installing.
## Develop
| Command | What it does |
| `npm run build` | Bundle `src/` into `lib/client.js` (main) and `lib/client.cinema.js` (lazy cinem

atic chunk). `-- --dev` skips minification, `-- --watch` rebuilds on change. |
| `npm test` | Run th

e unit-data, native-status adapter and mounted React lifecycle regression tests. |
| `npm run fonts`
| Re-subset the fonts from the full OTF/TTF sources (`EVA_FONT_SRC`, default `/tmp/evafonts`) to th

e characters used in `src/`. Run after changing any Japanese copy. |
| `npm run voice` | Render miss
ing announcer clips with edge-tts; `-- --force` re-renders all. Needs `python3 -m pip install --user
clips with edge-tts; `-- --force` re-renders all. Needs `python3 -m pip install --user edge-tts`. |
`scripts/harness/cinema.html` runs the cinematic on its own: serve the repository root with any stat
ic server and open `/scripts/harness/cinema.html`.
Unit-specific values (palette roles, surfaces, colour ramps, code tokens, number, pilot callsign, ev
ery cinematic line and its spoken reading) live in `src/shared/units.js`. Units share one data shape
(`tests/units.test.mjs` checks it); art is drawn once in template colours and recoloured per unit,
and voice clips common to all units are `assets/voice/shared-*.mp3`. Adding a unit = one entry in `U
NITS`, its `backdrop-right-NN.svg` / `mark-NN.svg` (`scripts/gen-backdrop.py`; the unit's line art c
omes from `scripts/mech/unit-NN.json`, traced from a flat-colour front-view image by `scripts/trace-
mech.py`, which needs `potrace`), its confirm/title clips (`npm run voice`), and the id in the `unit
` union of `lib/index.js`.
`scripts/harness/cinema.html?unit=01` previews another unit's cinematic.
### Switching units
The selected unit is the durable `unit` field (`"01"` | `"02"`, default `"02"`) of the `theme-eva` s
ettings section, so the settings UI, `configForms.get("theme-eva").set("unit", "01")` or a settings-
document edit all switch it. While the page is open the plugin also publishes a handle:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Each unit registers its own DSH theme (`eva-01` / `eva-02`); a switch activates the new theme before
retracting the old one, so there is no flash of the stock palette. The skin and component styles re
ad `--eva-accent`, `--eva-marking`, `--eva-green`, … custom properties, which other plugins can use
too (`body[data-eva-theme]` holds the unit id).

ed with Microsoft's ja-JP-NanamiNeural voice through edge-tts, and Microsoft has not granted an expl
icit redistribution license for such output. See NOTICE.md for details and for how to remove or repl

n tracing of the Evangelion Unit-01 / Unit-02 designs, which belong to their rights holders. "Evange
lion" and related names are trademarks of their respective owners.
